rule_outs: Dwelling 8 m from the best section
summary: Short residential kerb with houses 8-10 m away along its whole length.

drivers.seclusion: Houses at 9 m (0-5 m), 8 m (7 m) and 10 m (17 m) back directly onto the kerb.
drivers.access_and_room: Open street, cars park along the kerb; room for a van.
drivers.convention: Residential parking with 2P resident-permit signs; no sign of overnight stays.

flags: Dwellings within 10 m of every part of the stretch
sun_shade: Large tree at the west end shades the morning-to-midday; open to afternoon sun.

best_section.where: Marmion Parade north kerb at the corner, beside the house frontages
